faq.title: Questions before you book?
faq.body: The essentials, without the fine print.

cost.question: Does it cost the customer to book?
cost.answer: TRIMME shows each shop's own service prices before you choose. Any payment terms are shown as part of the shop and booking details.

download.question: Do I need to download an app?
download.answer: No. You can discover shops and complete your booking in the website from your phone.

barber.question: Can I choose a specific barber?
barber.answer: Yes, when the shop offers that option. You can choose an available barber or ask for any available barber to see more times.

confirmation.question: How do I know the booking is confirmed?
confirmation.answer: After you confirm, the appointment is recorded in TRIMME and its details are sent through the shop's configured notification channel, including WhatsApp when enabled.

changes.question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
changes.answer: Open the appointment in your account to see the available cancellation or rescheduling options and the shop's policy.

finalCta.title: Ready for a better way to book?
finalCta.body: Find a nearby shop, pick the right barber and choose a time that is actually free.

service.title: The service
